payload.text: ST0001 WP09 AC-09.1: AT-09.1 as vc decision 21 rules it. A new test in tests/cli.rs, the_live_store_asks_the_sidecar_for_dump_backup_and_group_only. (1) SidecarStore::new on a missing sidecar refuses, naming bin/devbin build, and the path is still absent after. (2) A stand-in sidecar is asked for each of dump, backup and group and for nothing else, with one measured mutant in the same cargo ask, eg the allowed set without group, going red. (3) It reads only main.swift's mode switch, fails naming why when there is no switch or no case label, and compares the labels as a set with AC-09.1's three names. The note names AT-10.1, AT-11.1 and json.rs's unit tests. Red in a worktree of 294b421's parent, green at main. Measure any time; land only after hv's push of main as vc verified it (b245b53, decision 20)
